subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world multi-step word problems involving right triangle trigonometry or coordinate proof, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student solves a realistic scenario (height/distance measurement, navigation) using right triangle trigonometry
exercise.pictorial: Student draws and labels a diagram representing the problem before solving
exercise.abstract: Student solves a multi-step trigonometry or coordinate geometry word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: cannot correctly identify the reference angle and corresponding sides in a real-world diagram

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
